title: Gabriel Santos - ASCII Art Techniques & Animation
speaker: Gabriel Santos
description:
This talk is from the 2019 Roguelike Celebration - find out more at https://roguelike.club/event2019.html

Gabriel is a life-long developer who loves games, ASCII-art and dogs, and respects the Sun more than usual.
